claim: The demo runs two sample duplicate deliveries and shows one payment effect.
where: Landing first screen, demo page, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:demo-one-click
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; run the sample and assert two deliveries and one recorded effect.

claim: Demo data uses the demo browser namespace and Reset demo returns the sample to an empty result.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:demo-reset-isolation
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; populate the sample, inspect storage namespaces, then reset.

claim: The sample reports a duplicate payment effect for a broken handler and passes again with an idempotent handler.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:duplicate-detection
sandbox: Fresh browser context; run Broken handler, then recover with Idempotent handler.

claim: The sample can run a reordered delivery and still check for one payment effect.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:reordered-sample
sandbox: Fresh browser context; choose Reordered delivery and assert the retry is first and the result passes.

claim: The demo is available offline after its first visit.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:offline-demo
sandbox: New browser context; install the service worker on /demo, then reload while offline.

claim: The demo sends requests only to this site and uses no analytics request.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:same-origin-demo
sandbox: Fresh browser context records every request while the demo runs and permits only the local product origin.

claim: The sample payment and email adapters record effects without calling a provider.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:inert-adapters
sandbox: Built browser package records payment and email effects while a fetch spy proves no request is made.

claim: Reports omit payload values and raw handler error text.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:secret-safe-report
sandbox: Built browser package throws a payload-derived handler error and asserts serialized output omits the marker.

test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:loopback-only
sandbox: Built Node package attempts a remote URL and asserts it is refused before a request is made.

claim: Scenarios require synthetic identifiers and reject secret-bearing payload fields.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:synthetic-identifiers
sandbox: Built browser package validates live-looking identifiers and a secret-bearing payload field.

claim: The MIT-licensed package runs locally as ESM, CommonJS, browser entry, and CLI.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:local-package
sandbox: A fresh temporary consumer installs npm pack output, runs an ESM duplicate proof, checks CommonJS and browser entry, runs the CLI against a loopback handler, and reads LICENSE.
